solutionSql:
(SELECT id FROM shipments ORDER BY id LIMIT 3)
UNION ALL
(SELECT id FROM invoices ORDER BY id LIMIT 3)
ORDER BY id;

ambiguities.readingChosen: One combined list sorted by id, so equal ids sit next to each other (1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3).
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Two blocks: the three shipment ids in order, then the three invoice ids in order (1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3).

notes: UNION ALL keeps the repeats. The ticket does not say whether the two lists should interleave, so the block-ordered answer would differ.
